walks.name: Downtown Shattuck
walks.vibe: The city's main library, a big bookstore and busy BART crowds.

start.n: Right at the station exit on Shattuck. On Saturdays the farmers market is two blocks west.
start.a: Shattuck Ave and Center St, Berkeley, CA 94704

stops.n: Saturday 10 to 2:30. Walk the stalls and chat, but hand out flyers only if the team has a booked table.
stops.a: Center St and Martin Luther King Jr Way, Berkeley, CA 94704

stops.n: Hand flyers to staff at the desk. Staff approve and pin everything, and items stay up to 30 days.
A big new and used bookstore. Ask if they have a community board or window space.
Say hello. They run breathwork and qigong classes, and the team has a booth here on Dec 6. Ask about their board.
A French bistro with a patio, open for breakfast and lunch. A nice place to sit down after.

bonus.n: A green spot by City Hall.
list: 2151 Martin Luther King Jr Way, Berkeley, CA 94704

walks.name: North Shattuck
walks.vibe: Food co-ops, coffee and a leafy park, busiest on Thursday market afternoons.

start.n: About 10 minutes north of Downtown Berkeley BART. Buses 7 and 18 stop nearby.
start.a: Shattuck Ave and Vine St, Berkeley, CA 94709

stops.n: The original Peet's. Ask the barista if a flyer can go by the door or on a board.
A yoga studio upstairs. Ask the front desk if they keep a community board for classes and events.
A worker-owned bakery and cheese shop. Ask a worker where community flyers go.
A neighborhood deli that hosts community events. Ask if they have window space.
Sit by the creek under the oaks. YogaKula holds outdoor classes here.

walks.name: Telegraph Avenue
walks.vibe: Bookstores and street life just south of campus.

start.n: Bus 6 runs on Telegraph. Downtown Berkeley BART is a 10 minute walk.
start.a: Telegraph Ave and Bancroft Way, Berkeley, CA 94704

stops.n: An independent bookstore. Ask if they post community events.
Four floors of books. Ask at the counter about a board or the window.
A small bookstore. Ask if a flyer can go by the door.
A quiet neighborhood park a few blocks southeast.

bonus.n: Head west to the Hana booth site.

walks.name: South Berkeley and Lorin
walks.vibe: A big grocery, a library and a weekend flea market by BART.

start.n: A 10 minute walk from Ashby BART. Bus 18 runs on Shattuck nearby.

stops.n: A busy independent grocery. Ask at the service desk if there is a community board.
Tarea Hall Pittman South Branch, open Sundays too. Hand flyers to staff at the desk.
Saturday and Sunday 9 to 5 in the Ashby BART lot. Chat with vendors and ask before leaving a flyer.
stops.a: Adeline St and Ashby Ave, Berkeley, CA 94703

stops.n: Open Monday to Thursday, 9 to 4. Ask the front desk where community notices go.
A neighborhood bakery in the Lorin District. Treat yourself.

bonus.n: A park on the way back.

walks.name: Solano Avenue
walks.vibe: A long, friendly shopping street with small shops and a bookstore.

start.n: On the team's sheet for Nov 21. Bus 18 runs along Solano.

stops.n: A small German pretzel bakery. Ask if a flyer can go in the window.
A neighborhood grocery. Ask at customer service if they have a community board.
An independent bookstore. Ask about the window or a board by the door.
Tacos and burritos for a break.
A short uphill walk. Sit on the rocks and look out over the bay.

bonus.n: A library a few blocks south.

walks.name: Elmwood and Ashby
walks.vibe: Bookshops and a branch library on a gentle stroll.

start.n: On the team's sheet for Nov 21, two blocks east of Telegraph. Bus 6 runs on Telegraph.

stops.n: Hand flyers to staff at the desk. Staff decide and pin them.
A literary and garden bookstore. Ask about window space or a board.
A bookstore with a small bar. Ask if they post local events.
A quiet park to sit for a bit.

walks.name: Hopkins and Monterey Market
walks.vibe: A beloved produce market, a new cafe and a quiet library.

start.n: Bus 18 stops nearby on Monterey Ave.
start.a: Hopkins St and Monterey Ave, Berkeley, CA 94707

stops.n: A famous independent produce market. Ask staff if there is a spot for community flyers.
A new cafe in the old Espresso Roma spot. Grab a drink and ask about the window.
Open Sundays too. Hand flyers to staff at the desk.
A short walk east. Rest by the creek.

walks.name: San Pablo and University
walks.vibe: Everyday errands, a laundromat and an eco store on a working street.

start.t: University Ave and San Pablo Ave
start.n: Bus 72 runs on San Pablo and bus 51B on University.
start.a: University Ave and San Pablo Ave, Berkeley, CA 94702

stops.n: Hand flyers to staff at the desk. Staff approve and pin them.
Open 7am to 10pm. Laundromats often have a board, so ask the attendant first.
Open Wednesday to Saturday, 12 to 6. Ask staff if they post community notices.
A big neighborhood park a few blocks east. Sit and rest.

walks.name: Fourth Street and Bowl West
walks.vibe: Polished shops, a lagoon walk and a big grocery near the bay.

start.n: Berkeley Amtrak is close by. Bus 51B ends near University and Fourth.
start.a: Fourth St and Hearst Ave, Berkeley, CA 94710

stops.n: A bookstore for design and general readers. Ask about a board or the window.
Walk along the lagoon and watch the birds.
A chocolate and art shop inside a cafe. Ask about posting.
Ask at the service desk about a community board, then grab a snack at the cafe.

walks.name: Colusa Circle
walks.vibe: A tiny village circle with a bakery and a Sunday market.

start.n: Just north of Solano up Colusa Ave. This bit is Kensington, not Berkeley city.
start.a: Colusa Ave and Oak View Ave, Kensington, CA 94707

stops.n: On the team's sheet for Nov 21. Say hello and ask about a flyer by the front desk.
Sunday mornings at the circle. Chat with the manager about a community table.
stops.a: Oak View Ave and Colusa Ave, Kensington, CA 94707

stops.n: The original Semifreddi's shop. Grab bread or a cookie and ask about the window.
